Stated Claim / Post Context:
DHS Secretary Mullin claims 300,000 noncitizens under investigation for illegally voting

The Trump administration has made potential noncitizens voting a central theme of its attempts to interfere with states’ elections.

Actual Article Body:
By Andrew Childers

October 31, 2026

to see more of our voting rights news coverage when you search.

Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Secretary Markwayne Mullin claimed his department is investigating 300,000 cases of potential noncitizens voting, with 1,600 active investigations.

The Trump administration has made potential noncitizens voting its central message heading into the midterm elections Tuesday, repeatedly claiming without evidence that it is widespread. The administration has used those allegations to try to interfere with states’ constitutional authority to administer elections.

“All we’re trying to do is make sure we secure our elections,” Mullin said in a Fox News interview.

Join 350,000 readers who rely on our daily and weekly newsletters for the latest in voting, elections and democracy.

In reality, repeated studies have shown that noncitizens voting is exceedingly rare and never happens in sufficient numbers to change the outcome of an election.

The Trump administration sent five states lists of alleged noncitizens who are supposedly registered to vote illegally. The administration sued California after the state refused to remove 20,000 people from the voting rolls that the Department of Justice (DOJ) claimed were “likely” noncitizens. It filed a separate suit alleging Washington failed to remove 400 people from its voting eligibility list.

“They’re not being transparent with their elections. They’re not being transparent with who voted in past elections,” Mullin said.

Both California and Washington said a cursory examination of the lists found several errors, including American citizens, inactive voters and people who never registered to vote.

Mullin has made grandiose claims about noncitizens voting in the past that later fizzled under closer scrutiny. In July, Mullin claimed that DHS had identified over 250,000 noncitizens registered to vote in California, New Jersey, Nevada and Pennsylvania. Specifically in Nevada, he claimed his department identified more than 15,000 noncitizens registered to vote. That number was revised to 185 people, all of whom were later shown to be American citizens.

Despite that, Mullin pressed on, blaming Democrats for fostering sanctuary cities that become a “melting pot for criminal activity.”

“The Democrats, the only thing they’re for is sowing chaos and disruption. They’re not for anything else,” Mullin said.

Mullin’s comments come as a federal judge on Saturday questioned the Trump administration’s attempt to “purge” voting rolls using lists including “higher numbers of maybe citizens of certain descent.”

Stated Claim / Post Context:
Deputy Secretary of State: Doomed Migrant Caravans Show Cartels' Hidden Power

The quick failure of migrant "caravans" shows how mass migration will quickly restart if Democrats loosen the nation's border defenses, says Christopher Landau, the deputy secretary of state.
The post Deputy Secretary of State: Doomed Migrant Caravans Show Cartels’ Hidden Power appeared first on Breitbart.

Actual Article Body:
The quick failure of migrant “caravans” shows how mass migration will quickly restart if Democrats loosen the nation’s border defenses, says Christopher Landau, the deputy secretary of state.

“The criminals and caravan organizers have not vanished or given up,” said Landau, who served as the U.S. ambassador to Mexico from 2019 to 2021. “Even now, they continue to organize caravans that have ZERO CHANCE of entering our country.”

For the migrant industry, the migrants “themselves are just the pawns, often subject to inhuman and degrading treatment along the way,” he wrote:

Some people mistakenly believe that human “caravans” seeking to enter our country illegally are an organic phenomenon. They are assuredly not. They are meticulously organized on social media, and — under the prior Administration — became a massive and lucrative business, primarily for criminal enterprises.

Many migrants join the convoys to get jobs in the United States, mostly because their home economies are paralyzed by corruption, lack of U.S. investment, and the loss of younger people who have moved into the U.S. economy.

Trump’s immigration officials work with Central American nations and Mexico to block the caravans as quickly as they appear, Landau wrote:

Under the leadership of @POTUS @realDonaldTrump, all of this stopped immediately and we now have THE MOST SECURE BORDER IN HISTORY …

An important part of our strategy is to work closely with authorities in other countries to stop caravans before they even approach our border. In this regard, we commend the Guatemalan, Honduran, and Mexican governments for their recent decisive and effective actions. By setting up checkpoints and working closely with @DHSgov, these authorities halted mass illegal travel in its tracks. Enforcing border security at the source delivers results.

Breitbart News reported October 30:

The latest migrant caravan, “Fe y Esperanza #2,” is making very little progress in its trek to reach the United States-Mexico border. At least four members of the caravan have been injured in fights that have broken out within the group. …

According to a report by La Jornada, a daily Spanish-language newspaper published in Mexico City, the caravan is currently moving toward Pijijiapan, Chiapas, having only managed to walk fewer than 90 miles over the last eight days. The group left the Mexican border city of Tapachula, Chiapas, on October 20 and has been plagued by foul weather throughout the walk along the southern coastal highway in Chiapas.

Since 1965 and 1990, the federal government’s economic policy of mass migration — and the resulting bubble of cheap labor — has been a huge boon for employers and investors in many sectors, such as real estate, restaurant, construction, eldercare, slaughterhouse, hotel, and entertainment sectors.

The inflow has also been a huge gain for the Democratic Party’s urban political machines.

But this policy of Extraction Migration has imposed huge costs on Americans and their children. Those costs include reduced wages, less workplace investment, and costlier housing.

Trump and his deputies have blocked the flow of migrants through the southern border and have sharply reduced the inflow of legalized migrants via the airports.
